content:
This confirms all findings. I have enough to answer.

h14.

**Computation site:** `internal/markdown.Service.ExtractAll` (and the equivalent `ExtractProperties`) in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:193-241,356-421`, invoked through `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`. This function parses `memo.Content` with goldmark and writes the result into `memo.Payload.Property` / `memo.Payload.Tags` (`storepb.MemoPayload`, `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:24-31,85-96`).

**Triggers (recomputation happens whenever content is (re)written):**
- Memo creation — `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` on the newly-built `store.Memo` before it is persisted.
- Memo update — `UpdateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:434-451` calls `RebuildMemoPayload` again, but only when the update mask includes the `content` path (i.e. only if the body actually changed; other field updates like visibility/pinned don't retrigger it).
- A background maintenance job — `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`) batch-lists all memos and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each, letting stored payloads be backfilled/repaired en masse (e.g. after a schema/extraction-logic change), independent of any user edit.

**Extracted properties (`storepb.MemoPayload_Property`, `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go:85-96`, populated in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:199-241` / `362-408`):**
- `Title` — text of the first block-level node if it's an H1 heading.
- `HasLink` — true if any Markdown link node is present.
- `HasCode` — true if any code block, fenced code block, or code span is present.
- `HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox (`- [ ]`/`- [x]`) exists.
- `HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any task checkbox is unchecked.
- Alongside this, the same single-pass walk (`ExtractAll`) also collects `Tags` (`#tag` nodes) and `Mentions` (`@username` nodes) which get stored in `memo.Payload.Tags` — these are also derived-from-content metadata used for filtering/search, not user-set fields.
